en.headline: Victoria Park stall 1 lets for 34,000 dollars, down on last year
en.dek: Now News said the large dry-goods pitch that fetched about 50,000 dollars last year went for 34,000 dollars on the second auction day.
body: Bidding for dry-goods stalls at next year's Victoria Park Lunar New Year fair moved to its second day on Thursday, and the pitch that was last year's top large stall let for less.

Now News reported that stall 1, a large dry-goods pitch with a reserve of 12,810 dollars, sold for 34,000 dollars. The same stall fetched about 50,000 dollars last year, and the same bidder took it again. The operator, identified as Mr Lai, told the station he had expected to pay 50,000 to 60,000 dollars. He said he planned to sell traditional snacks, including put chai ko and candied fruit, and that he believed trade would improve because more people were returning.

The station said large dry-goods stalls measure 4.5 metres by 2 metres, and that several pitches, including stalls 6 and 17 at the football-pitch entrances, went for more than 40,000 dollars. One call of 48,000 dollars was heard during the session.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has set the Victoria Park auction across three days at the Lai Chi Kok Government Offices, with dry-goods stalls on Thursday and Friday. Now News said the remaining 78 dry-goods stalls are due to be auctioned on Friday. The fair itself is scheduled for 31 January to 6 February 2027 at 14 sites across Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 維園年宵1號乾貨檔以3.4萬元成交 低過去年
zh.dek: Now新聞報道，去年以約5萬元投得的大型乾貨1號檔，周四以3.4萬元由同一人再投得。
body: 明年維園年宵市場周四進入乾貨攤位競投，去年的大型檔王成交價低於上年。
Now新聞報道，底價12,810元的大型乾貨1號檔以34,000元成交，去年約為50,000元，由同一人投得。檔主黎先生向該台表示，原本預期要五六萬元。他說打算一如以往售賣砵仔糕、冰糖葫蘆等舊式小食，並相信人流回流後生意會較好。
該台指大型乾貨檔為4.5米乘2米。球場出入口的6號及17號等檔位成交價超過4萬元，現場亦聽到4.8萬元的叫價成交。
食環署安排維園攤位周三至周五在荔枝角政府合署競投，周四及周五為乾貨檔。Now新聞稱其餘78個乾貨攤位周五競投。年宵市場訂於2027年1月31日至2月6日，在全港14個地點舉行。
